facts.text: Kitty has to go home, Mike. But she does not leave without a proper goodbye. Make the reservation.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Sulley's words, but he never says it. 'Kitty' is what Boo calls Sulley, not what he calls her. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Mike's got Celia at Harryhausen's tonight. Nobody bring a toddler, and nobody wear a sock.
